description: AGSC-07-13a, added at rc.6 (ENG7-03): the bytes of the archive AGSC-09-09's `--zip` writes. Two files, so that the whole container can be derived by hand and compared field by field; expected values derived by hand from the rule text and from APPNOTE.TXT, not from a run of any engine, and then unpacked with an independent third-party reader to confirm the container is a real ZIP. Derivation. (1) ORDER: the writer is handed `diagram.mmd` first, but entries are stored in code-point order of the entry name, and `A` is U+0041 while `d` is U+0064, so `AGENTS.md` is stored first. The input order never reaches the bytes. (2) TIME: the build instant is 2026-09-16T12:34:56Z, and its own UTC digits fill the MS-DOS fields — date = ((2026 - 1980) << 9) | (9 << 5) | 16 = 23552 + 288 + 16 = 23856 = 0x5D30; time = (12 << 11) | (34 << 5) | (56 >> 1) = 24576 + 1088 + 28 = 25692 = 0x645C. No clock and no zone is read, so `TZ` cannot reach the archive. (3) SIZES: `AGENTS.md` is 9 name bytes and 10 data bytes, `diagram.mmd` 11 and 13. A local file header is 30 bytes plus the name, so the first entry occupies 30 + 9 + 10 = 49 bytes at offset 0 and the second 30 + 11 + 13 = 54 bytes at offset 49; the central directory therefore starts at 103. A central-directory record is 46 bytes plus the name, so the directory is (46 + 9) + (46 + 11) = 112 bytes, and the end-of-central-directory record is 22: 103 + 112 + 22 = 237 bytes in all. (4) CHECKSUMS: CRC-32/ISO-HDLC over each entry's bytes, ccc8bbfa over "# Harness\n" and e55d7f21 over "flowchart TD\n". (5) FIELDS: method 0 (stored) with the compressed size equal to the uncompressed size, version-needed 20, the general-purpose bit flag 0x0800 and nothing else, extra-field length 0, and in the central directory version-made-by 20 with no attributes, all comment and disk fields 0, and each entry's local-header offset. Nothing optional is written, so the archive is the entry names, the entry bytes and the instant and nothing else. (6) NAME: AGSC-04-25's tenth stamping place — the directory, the content version, `.zip`; a value outside that rule's grammar becomes `unversioned`, so the name says plainly that it names no state rather than naming a wrong one.
note: added 2026-09-22 at rc.6 (RC6-C) for the new rule AGSC-07-13a; expected values derived by hand from the rule text and APPNOTE.TXT; unreleased, may be edited in place until the rc.6 tag
